source: Dashboard & Agent Spawning v2 spec — two layers turning the daemon into a visible control plane

items.description: Install ink, @inkjs/ui, and ink-text-input dependencies
items.approach: Add ink (React for terminals), @inkjs/ui (Badge, ProgressBar, Spinner, Select, TextInput, ConfirmInput, StatusMessage, OrderedList), and ink-text-input as production dependencies. These are lazy-imported by dashboard/run commands only.

items.description: Daemon HTTP client wrapper for dashboard polling
items.approach: Create a DaemonClient class using Node fetch. Methods: listTraversals(), inspectTraversal(id), getGraphs(), resetTraversal(id), startTraversal(graphId), contextSet(id, updates). Handles connection errors gracefully. Configurable host/port.

items.description: Two-panel responsive layout component
items.approach: Ink Box-based flexbox layout. Three breakpoints: wide (>=120 cols) full two-panel 40/60 split, medium (80-119) narrow left panel, narrow (<80) single panel with forward/back navigation. Uses useStdout() for terminal width detection.

items.description: Left panel traversal row component
items.approach: Shows status indicator (● active, ◌ waiting, ✓ complete, ✗ failed), graph name, current node name, ProgressBar (from @inkjs/ui) for nodes visited/total, duration. Wait nodes show ⏳ with timeout remaining.

items.description: Right panel detail view component
items.approach: Shows graph metadata, timing, current node with type Badge, context key-value pairs (scrollable), history (timestamped transitions), available edges with conditions, gate validations with StatusMessage. Sections are collapsible.

items.description: Available edge with live condition evaluation
items.approach: Shows edge label, target, condition expression, and live ● (true) / ○ (false) indicator evaluated from current context in real time.

items.description: Polling loop with differential updates
items.approach: Custom React hook. Active traversals poll every 2s, waiting every 5s, completed on initial load only. Diffs responses and only triggers re-render on actual changes. Intervals configurable via dashboard.json.

items.description: Leader key + arrow key navigation system
items.approach: OpenCode-style leader key (ctrl+x default). useInput from ink for key handling. Leader key sets a pending state, next keypress dispatches action. Arrow keys for list selection, Tab for panel switch, Enter for expand, Escape for back. Keybinds loaded from ~/.freelance/dashboard.json if it exists.

items.description: Main dashboard app component and entry point
items.approach: Top-level Ink App component composing PanelLayout, TraversalRow list, DetailPanel. Manages selected traversal state, expanded/collapsed view, overlay stack. Entry point connects to daemon (error + start command hint if not running), renders App via ink render().

items.description: Register 'freelance dashboard' CLI command
items.approach: Add dashboard subcommand to Commander program with --port option. Handler checks daemon is running (via DaemonClient health check), then lazy-imports and renders the dashboard app. If daemon not running, prints error with 'freelance daemon start' hint.

items.description: Graph picker overlay for new traversal
items.approach: Uses @inkjs/ui Select component. Lists available graphs from daemon with name + description. Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to confirm (calls startTraversal), Escape to cancel. Rendered as overlay on top of current view.

items.description: Wait node signal overlay with dynamic form
items.approach: Uses @inkjs/ui TextInput for each waitOn field. Shows traversal name, waiting conditions. Tab between fields. Boolean fields show toggle, string fields show text input. Enter to submit (calls contextSet), Escape to cancel.

items.description: Reset confirmation overlay
items.approach: Uses @inkjs/ui ConfirmInput. Shows traversal name and ID, warns about clearing context/history. Y to confirm (calls resetTraversal), n or Escape to cancel.

items.description: Help overlay showing all keybinds and slash commands
items.approach: Static content overlay listing navigation keys, leader key actions, and slash commands. Escape to close. Content generated from the active keybind configuration so custom bindings are reflected.

items.description: Slash command input bar in status area
items.approach: TextInput that activates on '/' keypress. Parses command and args, dispatches to appropriate action (new, reset, signal, graphs, filter, help, quit). Shows in the status bar area. Escape to cancel.

items.description: ASCII flow graph map with current node highlighted
items.approach: Renders simplified ASCII flow: node names in sequence following edge order. Current node in [brackets], visited nodes normal, unvisited dimmed. Branch points shown with indentation (├─/└─). Generated client-side from graph definition + traversal history. Linear graphs trivial, branching follows edges depth-first.

items.description: Agent registry with CLI commands and MCP config patterns
items.approach: Define registry mapping agent names to their CLI commands, MCP config methods, and permission bypass flags. Support claude-code, opencode, cursor, and custom (user-provided --agent-cmd). Each entry knows how to construct the spawn command.

items.description: Initial prompt generation from graph first node
items.approach: Generate prompt text that tells the agent about its active traversal, graph ID, and to call graph_inspect. For --resume, include current node and state hint. Append user's --prompt text if provided.

items.description: Child process spawning with PID tracking
items.approach: Use Node child_process.spawn to launch agent with appropriate CLI args and MCP configuration. Track PID. Support --attach (inherit stdio) and --detach (pipe to log file). Log to ~/.freelance/logs/<traversal-id>.log for detached mode.

items.description: Daemon agent registration API endpoints
items.approach: Add three endpoints: POST /traversals/:id/agent (register PID + type), GET /traversals/:id/agent (get status: running/exited/none via process.kill(pid, 0) check), DELETE /traversals/:id/agent (kill process). Store agent info in traversal metadata.

items.description: Log file management for detached agents
items.approach: Manage ~/.freelance/logs/ directory. Create log files per traversal ID. Provide tail-reading function for dashboard log viewer. Handle log rotation/cleanup for old traversals.

items.description: Resume logic for existing traversals
items.approach: freelance run --resume <id> spawns new agent for active traversal. Validates traversal exists and is active. Generates resume prompt with current node info. Registers new agent PID with daemon.

items.description: Register 'freelance run' CLI command
items.approach: Add run subcommand with options: <graph-id>, --agent, --prompt, --model, --cwd, --attach, --detach, --port, --resume. Orchestrates: start traversal → generate prompt → spawn agent → register with daemon. Connects to daemon (starts it if needed or errors).

items.description: Agent status display in dashboard
items.approach: TraversalRow shows 'agent: claude (pid 12345)' when agent attached. DetailPanel expanded view shows Agent section with type, PID, status (● running / ⚠ exited / ○ none), model, and log path. Polls agent status endpoint.

items.description: Agent kill from dashboard via leader+x
items.approach: Add <leader>x binding that calls DELETE /traversals/:id/agent. Show ConfirmInput before killing. Traversal stays active at current node after agent is killed.

items.description: Log viewer in expanded detail view
items.approach: Read-only tail of the agent log file. Shows last 20 lines by default. Updates in real time via polling. Scrollable with PageUp/PageDown when focused. Tab to switch focus between context/history/log sections.

items.description: Keybind customization via dashboard.json
items.approach: Load ~/.freelance/dashboard.json for keybind overrides, theme selection, and poll intervals. Merge with defaults. Support comma-separated multiple bindings per action (e.g., 'up,k'). Help overlay reflects active config.
